map.→ 打开Beta系数计算器工具: -> Open the Beta coefficient calculator tool
map.两组数据长度不一致会怎样？: What happens when the two data sets have different lengths?
map.多因子模型前，先用单因子 Beta 做初步风险分层。: Before a multi-factor model, use a single-factor beta for an initial risk stratification.
map.市场涨 1%，该股历史平均涨 1.2%；跌 1% 平均跌 1.2%。Beta 越: When the market rises 1% the stock has historically risen 1.2% on average, and when it falls 1% it falls 1.2% on average. A higher beta means more systematic risk, but not stock-specific risk (which diversification removes).
map.本工具要求个股与市场收益率一一对应、长度相同，否则报错。对齐日期后再算。: This tool requires stock and market returns to correspond one to one and have equal length, otherwise it errors out. Align the dates first.
map.用个股与市场收益率序列求协方差，除以市场收益率方差；等价于 β = ρ(s,m): Compute the covariance of the stock and market return series and divide by the variance of market returns; equivalently beta = rho(s,m) sigma_s / sigma_m, measuring systematic risk relative to the market.
map.由个股与市场收益率协方差与方差求 β: Compute beta from the covariance and variance of stock and market returns
map.给定个股与市场逐期收益率序列，计算个股相对市场的系统性风险 Beta。: Given period-by-period return series for a stock and the market, compute the Beta of systematic risk relative to the market.
map.输入个股与市场收益率序列，计算 Beta 系数、协方差与相关系数，衡量个股相对大: Enter stock and market return series to compute the Beta coefficient, covariance and correlation coefficient, measuring systematic risk relative to the broad market for CAPM pricing and portfolio risk assessment.
map.配合 CAPM 估算个股预期收益，或判断进攻/防守属性。: Combine with CAPM to estimate expected returns or judge offensive and defensive characteristics.
map.：无风险 3%、市场期望 8%、Beta=1.20：E(R)=3%+1.20×(: : with risk-free 3%, expected market return 8% and Beta = 1.20, E(R) = 3% + 1.20 x (8% - 3%) = 9%. A beta above 1 is offensive (higher risk and higher return).
